item.title: 21 Aug — ECB’s ‘Appia’ token rail; CFTC’s innovation huddle
item.description:
## What moved (window close: 2026-08-21 07:43 +04)
- headline: ECB names members for ‘Appia’ tokenisation contact group (Pontes/Appia program) what_happened: On Aug 19, the ECB said 61 firms and public bodies will join its new Appia contact group to support tokenised settlement rails alongside Pontes (DLT bridge to TARGET Services); the group starts work in September and will publish summaries…
